name: markdown-pdf
description: Generic, print-quality Markdown to PDF renderer

scripts.render: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js render
scripts.preview: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js preview
scripts.check: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js check
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js doctor
scripts.themes: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js themes
